gcloud.summary: Safety rules for any use of the gcloud CLI on Google Cloud: check leaf-level syntax with `gcloud help` before every command, always pass `--quiet` and `--project`, never run a `list` without `--limit`, `--filter` or `--format`, and never run delete, IAM, billing, org or KMS commands without a human saying yes. Two reference files cover install and authentication, and the remote Cloud CLI MCP server. It does not describe how to configure any particular product such as GKE.

gke-cluster-creation.summary: Walks an agent through creating a GKE cluster: gather project, region and name, pick Autopilot or Standard, then use one of five ready-made templates (golden-path Autopilot, Autopilot dev/test, Standard regional, L4 GPU, A3 hypercompute) given both as a gcloud command and as an MCP `create_cluster` payload. A team patch sets the default region to us-central1 and project to kitchen-prod-1234. It lists security, cost and HA best practices in brief and does not cover app deployment, detailed monitoring, or workload reliability.

gke-golden-path.summary: The reference list of golden-path Autopilot cluster settings (private nodes, Secret Manager, Dataplane V2, full monitoring suite, VPA, Stateful HA and so on), which settings a customer may change, guardrails, and a section on what to say about node upgrade disruption (PDBs, replicas, readiness probes, surge settings). A team patch makes clusters always regional and pins project kitchen-prod-1234. Used to design or audit a cluster against defaults; it does not walk through the create flow or cover workload autoscaling.

gke-observability.summary: Full guide to GKE monitoring and logging: the golden-path monitoring component list, how to enable control-plane metrics with `--monitoring` and the CLI versus API spelling trap, Managed Prometheus, `kubectl top`, `gcloud logging read` queries, alert thresholds, cost notes, tracing and profiling, LQL examples, and a long Managed Prometheus troubleshooting section (pods, PodMonitoring, permissions, rules, Grafana, quota). It does not cover app logging libraries or non-Google APMs.

gke-observability-fork.summary: A short nine-step checklist for GKE observability: check logging and monitoring config, enable Managed Prometheus, confirm workload logs reach Cloud Logging, suggest dashboards and alerts, recommend Cloud Trace and Cloud Profiler, two LQL examples, enable control-plane metrics, and enable Dataplane V2 observability. It has no troubleshooting, no cost guidance, and no table of golden-path defaults.

gke-reliability.summary: GKE workload reliability with MCP-first and kubectl fallback commands: verify the cluster is regional, Pod Disruption Budgets, liveness, readiness and startup probes with recommended timings, graceful shutdown with a preStop hook, zone and node topology spread, minimum replica counts by workload type, and a table of golden-path reliability defaults. It hands manifest generation, backup and DR, and maintenance windows to other skills.

gke-reliability-fork.summary: A short checklist for GKE reliability: verify the cluster is regional, a PDB example, which probes to have and how to check for them, a one-line note on graceful shutdown, a zone topology spread example, and a gcloud command to set a maintenance window. No MCP commands, no probe timings, no replica guidance.

gke-cluster-creation|gke-golden-path.reason: Both define the golden-path Autopilot defaults, the same required inputs, the same Day-0 warnings and the same team project id; cluster-creation adds templates and golden-path adds the full settings table and upgrade disruption advice.

gke-observability|gke-observability-fork.reason: Every one of the fork's nine steps (audit config, Managed Prometheus, workload logs, dashboards, tracing, profiling, LQL, control-plane metrics, Dataplane V2) appears in gke-observability with more detail, which also adds cost, alert thresholds and GMP troubleshooting; the fork's only extra is a one-line tip to log as JSON.

gke-reliability|gke-reliability-fork.reason: Five of the fork's six workflows (regional check, PDB, probes, graceful shutdown, topology spread) appear in gke-reliability with more detail plus MCP commands and replica guidance; the fork's only extra is a six-line maintenance-window command, which gke-reliability hands to the gke-upgrades skill.
